meta.title: SAAZ IDEA — Car Care & Protection Center in Jeddah
meta.description: SAAZ IDEA — a car care and protection center in Jeddah: PPF paint protection, interior & exterior nano ceramic, thermal insulation, and professional polishing. Certified 5-10 year warranty.

hero.title: We Protect Your Car And Give It Lasting Shine
hero.subtitle: At SAAZ IDEA we offer complete care for your car: PPF paint protection, thermal insulation, nano ceramic coating, and professional polishing — by a skilled team using globally certified materials.

about.title: About Us
descriptionParagraphs: At SAAZ IDEA, we believe your car isn't just a means of transport — it's a reflection of your taste and an investment that deserves the highest level of care and attention.
That's why we're committed to delivering a complete experience in car care, combining exceptional quality, precision in every detail, and the latest global technology.

We offer comprehensive, professional care to protect your car and preserve its value — starting with PPF protection film, through thermal insulation and nano ceramic coating, to professional polishing services — using the best globally certified materials, applied by a professional team that always strives for the highest standards of perfection.

list.title: PPF Paint Protection Film
list.desc: Professional protection for your car's paint against scratches and external factors using high-quality transparent film that preserves the car's look and value.

list.title: Exterior Nano Ceramic Coating
list.desc: An advanced protective layer applied to your car's paint for extra protection against dust and weather, while enhancing the paint's shine.

list.title: Thermal Insulation
list.desc: Reduces heat inside the car and blocks harmful rays to improve driving comfort and protect the interior from sun damage.

list.title: Interior Cleaning & Polishing
list.desc: Thorough cleaning of seats, floors, and interior surfaces to restore freshness and maintain the quality of the car's interior components.

list.title: Exterior Polishing
list.desc: Restores paint shine and removes usage marks and surface scratches for a brighter, more attractive look.

list.title: Interior Nano Ceramic Coating
list.desc: An advanced protective layer for interior surfaces that resists stains and dirt, keeping the cabin clean and fresh for longer.

items.q: Do I need previous marketing experience?
items.a: Experience is helpful but not required. We care about your ability to communicate clearly and reach an audience interested in car care.

items.q: How do I get my own marketing link?
items.a: After your application is accepted, we send you a code and a link of your own via WhatsApp or the email you registered.

items.q: When does the commission become due?
items.a: The commission is calculated after the booking value is fully collected and the transaction is approved by our team, per the program terms.
10% of the booking value after excluding VAT and deducting the actual total execution costs.

items.q: Are there any fees to join?
items.a: No, joining the program is completely free.
